full_judgment: 9. After passing the impugned order, the Artha Rin Adalat fixed the case on 9-9-2014 for taking steps by the writ-respondent bank and the writ-petitioner was not aware about the said date. It appears from the order sheet of the said Artha Zari Case that on 9-9-2014, the writ-respondent bank took steps for auction and the Artha Rin Adalat fixed on 2-10-2014 for auction of the mortgaged property without settling the claim of the respondent bank in accordance with law. Further on 13-9-2014, the writ-respondent Bank through an e-mail made proposal to settle the liability amicably out of Court. Under the said e-mail the writ-respondent bank forwarded a settlement agreement (Solenama) where the writ-respondent bank made an offer to settle the liability at Taka 22 crore though earlier the Artha Rin Adalat rejected the writ-petitioner's application dated 28-8-2014 and supplementary application dated 8-9-2014.
